Update for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric, on Linux, Windows and macOS).

### Better looking

- **Floating words are easier to read.** With the **World** layout, the words floating around you are about a third bigger, so you can read them from further away.
- **Floating words follow the CAPITALS switch.** They used to always be in capital letters. Now, like the rest of the lyrics, they're in normal writing unless **CAPITALS** is on.
